intro: Reveal your skin’s natural glow with Kabira Skincare Rice Water Scrub, a gentle herbal exfoliator made with the age-old secret of rice water. Known for its brightening and soothing properties, rice water helps cleanse, polish, and rejuvenate the skin, giving it a youthful and fresh appearance.

This luxurious scrub removes dirt, oil, and dead skin cells, helping to clear pores and improve skin texture. Its mild exfoliating beads ensure smooth skin without stripping away moisture. Ideal for all skin types, it promotes a clean, even, and radiant complexion after every use.

Apply a small amount of Rice Water Scrub to damp skin.
Gently massage in circular motions for 1-2 minutes, avoiding the eye area.
Pat dry and follow up with a moisturizer.
Use 2-3 times a week for best results.
